subject.title: improve: index transcript mirror persistence checks

question: Should OpenClaw publish a dedicated Plugin SDK indexed transcript write-lock API for the Codex and Copilot mirror optimization, or should these persistence facts remain internal until a broader plugin use case is approved?
rationale: This is an additive, documented public Plugin SDK surface, so code review alone cannot determine whether the mirror-specific contract is an acceptable long-term external API.

options.title: Sponsor the narrow SDK API
options.body: Approve the dedicated indexed write-lock context as the supported public seam, contingent on current-head real-runtime proof.

options.title: Keep facts internal
options.body: Move the optimization behind an internal transcript-accessor seam and avoid publishing the new Plugin SDK function and context.

options.title: Defer API expansion
options.body: Pause the PR until a broader external-plugin use case defines the intended durable contract.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the narrow SDK API
recommendation.body: Approve the dedicated indexed write-lock context as the supported public seam, contingent on current-head real-runtime proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The available feature history identifies this contributor as author of both the merged transcript-index foundation and the proposed follow-up; a repository maintainer still needs to make the product decision.
